remarks: Easy to show! Well-kept 2 bedroom / 2 Bathroom Patio Home - One of Marrano Builders most popular designs, Large Living Room / Dining Room Area with Vaulted Ceiling, Newer Hardwood Flooring and a Gas Fireplace.  Primary bedroom has full Bathroom and Walk-in Closet; and there is a Second Hall Bathroom on the First Floor. Also has a Large Loft Area (second floor) with walk-in closet (could be used as 3rd Bedroom). Kitchen has Built-in Appliances and a Breakfast Nook. Home has Covered Front Porch, a Rear Concrete Patio and an Attached 2 Car Garage.  Home also has a Large Basement Area that Could be an Ideal Area to Finish for Additional Rooms.  Laundry Room on First Floor.  Located Near End of Street (No Through Traffic); and Near Wooded Area (Town Property) with an additional Guest Parking Area across the Street. Located close to Town Park (Stiglemeir Park) and close to shopping and Thruway access.  Updates include New Hardwood Flooring (2023); New Roof 2023; Central A/C 2022; HW Tank 2023.  HOA Fee covers common area maintenance, Lawns / Hedge Trimming, Lawn Sprinkler Systems, Snow Removal, Trash / Garbage Collection, and Water & Sewer Utilities. See photos with comments for additional information.
